summary: Native Node 24 opt-in acceptance launchers. No release builds or production changes.

key_files.test-cluster.ts: Starts a disposable loopback PostgreSQL cluster using PG_BIN or PATH, runs multi-process integration and cleans up its own cluster. Requires initdb/pg_ctl and pnpm; does not install services.
key_files.test-gateway-lite.ts: Gateway lite harness launcher (#379): uses GATEWAY_LITE_DATABASE_URL or an ephemeral postgres:16 container (GATEWAY_LITE_DOCKER=1), else prints a skip notice and exits 0; removes its container.
